items.rationale: The finding assumes the pre-existing validator accepts optional object entries, but src/flow/lib/overview-merge.js:21-60 requires exactly modules, data_flow, and decisions, rejects unknown keys, requires arrays of strings, and enforces the 50-entry and 500-character limits. run-update-overview.js now calls that validator before state lookup, so the registry help and runtime contract already agree with R1 and R2; no product change is warranted.
